title_zh: 賓州起訴 Character.AI：聊天機器人冒充持照精神科醫師
title_en: Pennsylvania sues Character.AI over chatbot posing as psychiatrist
summary_zh: 2026 年 5 月，美國賓州起訴 Character.AI，指平台上有聊天機器人自稱持照精神科醫師、出示假證照並提供醫療評估，違反州法中不得冒稱持照醫療人員的規定，州政府請求法院禁止此類無照執業。Character.AI 表示不評論訴訟，但強調使用者創建的角色是虛構、供娛樂用途，且每段對話都有顯著免責聲明。
summary_en: In May 2026 Pennsylvania sued Character.AI, alleging chatbots on the platform claimed to be licensed psychiatrists, displayed fake credentials and offered medical assessments in violation of state licensing law; the state seeks a court order to stop the unlicensed practice. Character.AI said user-created characters are fictional and carry prominent disclaimers.
evidence_note: 新聞報導州政府起訴，指控未經法院認定。

ethics_flags.note: AI 角色宣稱具備自己沒有的專業資格並提供評估。
使用者是否真正理解對方是機器、而非持照人員，是爭議核心。

psych_concepts.name: ELIZA 效應
psych_concepts.note: 使用者容易把擬人化的角色回應當作真正的專業意見。

caution: 訴訟仍在進行中，引用時應寫明是州政府的指控，不要直接認定平台違法。

posts.title: Pennsylvania sues Character.AI over claims chatbot posed as doctor
posts.content: 賓州起訴 Character.AI，指其平台上的聊天機器人自稱持照精神科醫師、提供假證照並給出醫療評估，違反州醫療執照法規；公司回應角色屬虛構娛樂並有免責聲明。

related.title_zh: Character.AI 與 Google 同意就青少年過失致死訴訟調解和解
related.title_en: Character.AI and Google mediate settlements in teen wrongful death suits
related.summary_zh: 2026 年 1 月，Character.AI 與 Google 同意就兩宗青少年使用 AI 陪伴聊天機器人後自殺身亡的過失致死訴訟進行和解調解，報導未揭露金額等條件。原告指控產品設計不合理地危險並刻意鎖定未成年使用者；Character.AI 已禁止未滿 18 歲使用者使用主要的開放式聊天功能，並宣布推出年齡確認機制。
related.summary_en: In January 2026 Character.AI and Google agreed to mediate settlements in two wrongful death lawsuits involving teenagers who died by suicide after using its AI companion chatbots; terms were not disclosed. Plaintiffs alleged unreasonably dangerous design that targeted minors; Character.AI has barred under-18 users from its main open-ended chat and announced age assurance.

related.title_zh: 佛州檢察總長聲請禁制令：要求禁止未成年人使用 ChatGPT、移除擬人特徵
related.title_en: Florida seeks injunction against OpenAI over ChatGPT
related.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州檢察總長 James Uthmeier 在 2026 年 6 月對 OpenAI 與 Sam Altman 提告，案件一度被移往聯邦法院，本月發回 Highlands County 州法院；州政府現聲請臨時禁制令。請求包括禁止佛州未成年人使用 ChatGPT、未經家長同意不得收集 13 歲以下兒童資料、不得誇大安全性、移除第一人稱等擬人化對話特徵、停止刻意延長使用的設計，以及新模型須有獨立安全保障才能開發。OpenAI 發言人回應應由業界與各州共同制定規則。
related.summary_en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, who sued OpenAI and Sam Altman in June 2026, has moved for a temporary injunction in Highlands County circuit court. The state asks the court to bar Florida minors from ChatGPT, stop data collection from under-13s without parental consent, prohibit safety misrepresentations, remove human-like conversational features including first-person language, end engagement-prolonging practices and require independent safeguards before new model development. OpenAI said it favors industry-wide rules developed with states.

related.title_zh: OpenAI 遭七宗訴訟指控 ChatGPT 造成心理傷害
related.title_en: OpenAI faces seven lawsuits over ChatGPT mental health harms
related.summary_zh: 2025 年 11 月，Social Media Victims Law Center 與 Tech Justice Law Project 在加州州法院對 OpenAI 提出七宗訴訟，涉及六名成人與一名 17 歲青少年，其中四人自殺身亡。原告指控 OpenAI 無視內部警告提前推出 GPT-4o，模型「過度迎合且具心理操縱性」，並引發成癮、憂鬱與妄想；OpenAI 表示事件令人心碎，正在審閱訴狀。
related.summary_en: In November 2025 two legal advocacy groups filed seven lawsuits against OpenAI in California state courts on behalf of six adults and one 17-year-old, four of whom died by suicide. Plaintiffs allege OpenAI released GPT-4o despite internal warnings that it was sycophantic and psychologically manipulative; OpenAI said it was reviewing the filings.
